_meta.rules: Sentence case. Say what happens, not feature names. No exclamation marks except in success emails. {brand} is the operator's name; {sender} is the sender's display name or 'Someone'. Plurals use ICU syntax.

send.title: Send a secret
send.lede: Encrypted on this device before it leaves. The link opens once, and you’ll see when it does.
send.placeholder: Paste a password, an API key, a whole .env file… or just type.
send.drop_hint: Or drop files anywhere on this page
send.title_hint: Title · encrypted too. The recipient sees it before they reveal.
send.detected: Found {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}} in your paste
send.how_encrypted: The key stays in the link. Our server only stores scrambled data.
send.how_once: It’s deleted the moment it’s revealed, or when it expires.
send.how_know: Your links show when each one was opened.
send.keep_open: Keep this tab open. If the connection drops, the upload resumes where it stopped.
send.will_email: We’ll email {email} when it’s opened. It also shows in Your links.
send.error_offline: Couldn’t reach {host}. Nothing was uploaded, and your secret is still here.
send.retry_note: Retries keep the same encrypted data; nothing is sent twice.

policy.panel_title: Who can open it, and for how long
policy.who_link_help: Fastest. Send the link somewhere private.
policy.who_email_help: They confirm with a 6-digit code before revealing.
policy.passphrase_help: Ask for a passphrase you share another way, like a phone call.
policy.defaults_note: Defaults are set by the server owner.

dialog.destroy_body: “{title}” is deleted from the server now. Anyone who opens the link will see that you destroyed it. This can’t be undone.
dialog.qr_title: Scan to open on a phone
dialog.qr_note: The code holds the full link, key included. Scanning shows the sealed page; it doesn’t reveal anything until the person presses Reveal.

links.title: Your links
links.lede: Everything you sent or asked for. Statuses sync to your account; links themselves stay on the device that made them.
links.empty_body: Send a secret or ask someone for one. You’ll see it here with its status, and you can destroy it early.
links.import_receipt: Have a receipt link from another device?
links.contents: {fields, plural, =0 {} one {# field} other {# fields}}{both, select, true {, } other {}}{files, plural, =0 {} one {# file} other {# files}}

status.too_many_tries: Destroyed after too many wrong passphrases

receipt.revealed_detail: Deleted from the server in the same moment
receipt.unexpected_title: Didn’t expect it to be opened yet?
receipt.unexpected_body: Someone else may have the link. Rotate the password and send a new one.

request.title: Ask someone for a secret
request.lede: They get a link to a simple form. Their answer is encrypted for you, so not even this server can read it.
request.title_hint: What you need. They see this first.
request.only_you: Only your devices can open the answer.
request.key_note: Only this browser holds the key that opens the answer.

respond.add_more: Add a note or a file
respond.lock_note: Encrypted on this device for {sender} before it’s sent. {brand}’s server can’t read it.
respond.expires: This link works once and expires on {date}.
respond.sent_body: {sender} has been notified. This link doesn’t work anymore, so you can close this page.
respond.own: Send a secret of your own
respond.key_mismatch: This request can’t be answered safely: the key it uses doesn’t match the link. Ask {sender} for a new link.

reveal.contents: {fields, plural, =0 {} one {# field} other {# fields}}{both, select, true { and } other {}}{files, plural, =0 {} one {# file} other {# files}}
reveal.opens_once: Opens once. It’s deleted from the server when you reveal it.
reveal.nothing_opened: Loading this page didn’t open anything. Expecting a message from {brand}? Make sure the address is {host}.
reveal.email_only: Only {email} can open this. We just emailed a 6-digit code there.
reveal.passphrase_hint: {sender} should have given you the passphrase separately, for example on a call.
reveal.deleted_banner: Deleted from the server. This page is the only copy.
reveal.cleared: Cleared. The secret was deleted from the server.
reveal.clipboard_note: Copied values stay in your clipboard. Paste them into your password manager.
reveal.gone_opened_body: Each link opens once. If that wasn’t you, someone else may have seen it.
reveal.gone_tell: Tell {sender} so they can change the password and send a new link.
reveal.gone_expired_body: It was never opened, and it’s been deleted. Ask {sender} to send it again.
reveal.gone_destroyed_body: It was deleted before anyone opened it.
reveal.broken_title: Part of this link is missing
reveal.broken_body: Apps sometimes cut long links. The end of the link holds the key, so without it nothing can be opened. Nothing was revealed or deleted.
reveal.broken_fix: Copy the whole link again, including everything after #, or ask {sender} to resend it.
reveal.unsupported: {brand} needs a current browser to decrypt secrets on your device.

errors.invalid: Something in the form isn’t right. Check the highlighted field.
errors.sign_in_required: Sign in to {brand} to do this.
errors.forbidden: You don’t have access to this.
errors.reauth_required: Confirm it’s you to make this change.
errors.code_required: Enter the code we emailed to continue.
errors.wrong_code: That code didn’t work. {tries, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left.
errors.too_large: That file is too large. Files can be up to {limit}.
errors.wrong_passphrase: That passphrase didn’t work. {tries, plural, one {# try} other {# tries}} left, then the secret is destroyed and {sender} is told.
errors.rate_limited: Too many tries. Try again in {duration}.
errors.demo_locked: This is fixed in the demo.
errors.internal: Something went wrong on our side. Nothing was opened or deleted. Try again in a minute.
errors.offline: You’re offline. We’ll continue when you’re back.
errors.tampered: This secret couldn’t be decrypted because it was changed after it was sent. Ask {sender} to send it again.
errors.incomplete_link: Part of this link is missing.

signin.title: Sign in to send
signin.lede: {brand}’s secure share is for {brand} people. You don’t need an account to open a link or answer a request.
signin.wrong: That email and password don’t match.
signin.locked_out: Locked out? Run cryptex owner reset on the server.

setup.brand_lede: People trust a link more when it shows a name they know. You can change this later.
setup.https_ok: Detected from this request. HTTPS is working.
setup.https_missing: This address isn’t using HTTPS. Links are only private over HTTPS.
setup.setup_code_help: Printed in the server log when Cryptex first started.

server.attn_smtp_body: “Tell me when it’s opened” and email-only links are off until SMTP is configured.
server.attn_cleanup: Cleanup hasn’t run for {minutes} minutes. Check the server logs.
server.unsaved: {n, plural, one {# unsaved change} other {# unsaved changes}}
server.token_created_body: This is the only time it’s shown. It can send links as {email}.

demo.banner: Public demo. Links expire within an hour and everything is wiped nightly. Don’t send real secrets.
demo.recipient_banner: This came from a public demo. Don’t trust links from people you don’t know.
demo.title: Try Cryptex
demo.lede: Send yourself a test secret, then open the link in another browser.
demo.placeholder: Try something harmless, like “The wifi password is…”
demo.limit_body: The demo resets at 00:00 UTC, in {duration}. Links you already sent keep working until they expire.
demo.self_host_body: No limits, your domain, your branding. Takes about two minutes.
